reserveReview.rationale: Chronicle's independently verified holdings table identifies all 15 positions as of 2026-07-22: five overnight tri-party repo positions totaling $2.172 billion and ten U.S. Treasury bills totaling $395.910 million. The six curated slices preserve each repo counterparty and aggregate only the same-obligor Treasury bills; percentages are derived from the reported $2.568 billion aggregate portfolio market value.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle Proof of Asset position-level market values
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified position remains in the dated holdings table. Chronicle reports $2.568 billion of portfolio market value against 2.618 billion outstanding shares at $1, a 98.09% gross-holdings-to-share-value reference; Pharos preserves that reconciliation separately and does not treat it as proof of a contractual collateralization ratio. The public sources still do not disclose a token-holder loss waterfall or the confidential offering memorandum.

rwa.xyz BUIDL asset profile (service providers, bankruptcy-remote account segregation)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer-authored Arbitrum STEP application (2024-05-04) states BNY Mellon is the Fund's administrator and custodian and that the Fund's assets are held in one or more accounts in the name of the Fund, with subcustodians and depositories permitted; no other fund-level custodian is named in reviewed sources, so the documented custody is a single-provider concentration. rwa.xyz (2026-07-16) lists the account segregation as bankruptcy remote. Sub-custodian splits and rehypothecation restrictions are not stated in reviewed public sources.
